name: socialstream-studio
description: Cross-platform personal desktop scheduler & resumable video uploader for YouTube and Facebook Pages
author: Desktop App Architect

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/main.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron .
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n RENDERER,MAIN_TSC,ELECTRON "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run watch:electron" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist: npm run dist:mac && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64
